dct_description_sm: "Positions of troops were given in testimony before the Army Board at West Point, and laid down on maps by the witnesses and officers present on the field."

"Positions of troops were given in testimony before the Army Board at West Point, and laid down on maps by the witnesses and officers present on the field." "The Federal troops are shown in blue; the Confederate troops in red." "The red arrows show the route of the Confederate troops, Aug. 30th, p.m." Map has been annotated in red ink to show "Rickett's route on 29th," "Porter 9:20 a.m. 29th," and "Porter's corps 9:30 a.m. 29." Description derived from published bibliography. Scale 1:63,360. LC Civil War Maps (2nd ed.), 577.4 Available also through the Library of Congress web site as raster image.
